thread:
Maya: Quick sync — prepping a focused EBR for AtlasCorp next Wed. Draft slides here: https://drive.redwood.ai/ebrs/atlascorp-draft. Please: update the renewal-risk row, add any exec asks, and drop a 1-line onboarding status.
Jordan: On it. I'll add risk tier + estimated NRR impact by EOD (will put conservative + optimistic numbers).
Priya: Onboarding status: 75% complete. Blockers: SSO cert + roles mapping with IdP (security team triaged), Training: 2 sessions left (Thu 10am & Fri 3pm). Usage: core API calls +12% MoM.
Sam: I can own the 8-min customer demo. Need confirmation of two priority flows: 1) generative search, 2) embeddings rerank. Which do we highlight?
Maya: Highlight generative search + rerank. Also we should surface the Dedicated migration ask (cost predictability) as an explicit exec ask.
Jordan: Agreed. Slide idea: one slide for 'Ask' with CTA: reserve Dedicated pool for Q3 pilot — estimated monthly delta and expected latency gains.
Priya: I'll draft a one-paragraph ROI note for that slide and add timeline for SSO fix (target: next Wed). Will drop it into slide 6.
Sam: Demo script: will mock data and keep it <8 mins. Putting script in the deck notes. Also adding a single bullet on rollback/fallback to hosted.
Maya: Action list: Jordan = risk + NRR numbers; Priya = onboarding ops + blockers + ROI blurb; Sam = demo + notes; Maya = exec narrative + slide polish. Please update slide 4 (health snapshot) with one bullet each.
Jordan: Quick Q — for risk calc do we use ARR or ACV? I used ACV last quarter.
Priya: Use ACV for consistency with sales reporting.
Jordan: Cool. I'll do ACV.
Maya: Dry run: Fri 14:00. I'm scheduling a 45-min run (walkthrough + Q/A). If you can make it, react with :thumbsup: or reply here.
kevin-bot: Calendar invite created: "AtlasCorp EBR dry run" — Fri 14:00. Attendees: Maya, Jordan, Priya, Sam.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll prep the verbiage for the exec ask: 10 min CTO readout + 5 min budget decision.
Maya: Also, capture feedback from last QBR in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/feedback/atlascorp-qbr-feedback. Please add one line per feedback with mitigation and owner.
Sam: Adding a note now — Feedback: "SSO unclear timeline" -> Mitigation: dedicated SSO onboarding pod (owner: Priya).
Jordan: Added risk mitigation timeline + NRR impact to slide 7.
Priya: Updated slide 6 with onboarding checklist and target dates.
Maya: Nice. One more: can someone grab a single customer quote for slide 2? short — 1 sentence about value.
Sam: I'll pull one from the last call and paste into slide 2.
Jordan: Heads-up — Sales asked to include a short pricing comparison table. I'll add a small table in the appendix slide.
Maya: Perfect. Final checklist before dry run: 1) numbers on slide 7 (Jordan) 2) onboarding timeline + ROI bullet (Priya) 3) demo + notes (Sam) 4) exec narrative (Maya) 5) feedback doc one-liners (everyone). Please update by Thu EOD so we can polish Fri morning.
Priya: Will do.
Jordan: Will do.
Sam: Will do. One small ask: can Eng standby for demo if we hit an interactive bug? pinging eng-oncall in meeting notes.
Maya: Good call. I'll add eng-oncall to the dry-run invite as optional.
kevin-bot: Invite updated: eng-oncall (optional).
Maya: Thanks all — I'll review slide deck Thu morning and send final copy. If anything urgent, DM me.
Sam: 👍
Priya: 👍
Jordan: 👍
